title: Elemental Stones
description: Seven elemental ores with unique powers and abilities.
body:
# Elemental Stones

Elemental Stones adds 6 elemental ores to your Minecraft world, each with unique powers and abilities.

## Elements
- 🔥 **Ember** — Fire-based ore with fire resistance armor
- 💨 **Gale** — Wind-based ore
- 🌑 **Void** — Shadow-based ore
- 🪨 **Stone** — Earth-based ore
- 🌊 **Tide** — Water-based ore
- ⚡ **Storm** — Lightning-based ore

## Features
- Full tool set per element (sword, pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe)
- Full armor set per element with unique effects
- Custom mobs: Ember Golem and Water Golem(that generate when you get hert in the  **Ember** armor and the **Tide** armor
- All ores generate naturally in the overworld

## Requirements
- Fabric Loader 0.16.9+
- Fabric API
- Minecraft 1.21.1
